claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core deterministic effect is creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects. The current effect vocabulary can target an object, but it cannot author a cross-object bonded state with removal constraints.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: dual_object_attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing attachment grammar can point at one object, target, or area. Sovereign Glue requires selecting two object endpoints for one activation, not one.
